verses.he: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.en: A Psalm of David, to make memorial.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: O LORD, rebuke me not in Thine anger; Neither chasten me in Thy wrath.

verses.he: כִּֽי־חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: For Thine arrows are gone deep into me, And Thy hand is come down upon me.

verses.he: אֵין־מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין־שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

verses.he: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֹנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: For mine iniquities are gone over my head; As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.he: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃
verses.en: My wounds are noisome, they fester, Because of my foolishness.

verses.he: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃
verses.en: I am bent and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day.

verses.he: כִּֽי־כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.en: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.he: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי׃
verses.en: I am benumbed and sore crushed; I groan by reason of the moaning of my heart.

verses.he: אֲ‍ֽדֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ֥ כָל־תַּאֲוָתִ֑י וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־נִסְתָּֽרָה׃
verses.en: Lord, all my desire is before Thee; And my sighing is not hid from Thee.

verses.he: לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר־עֵינַ֥י גַּם־הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי׃
verses.en: My heart fluttereth, my strength faileth me; As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.he: אֹֽהֲבַ֨י׀ וְרֵעַ֗י מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י מֵרָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ׃
verses.en: My friends and my companions stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.he: וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל־הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ׃
verses.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; And they that seek my hurt speak crafty devices, And utter deceits all the day.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֣י כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־פִּֽיו׃
verses.en: But I am as a deaf man, I hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

verses.he: וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְאֵ֥ין בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Yea, I am become as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no arguments.

verses.he: כִּֽי־לְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.en: For in Thee, O LORD, do I hope; Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ׃
verses.en: For I said: 'Lest they rejoice over me; When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.'

verses.he: כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי לְצֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃
verses.en: For I am ready to halt, And my pain is continually before me.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עֲו‍ֹנִ֥י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.en: For I do declare mine iniquity; I am full of care because of my sin.

verses.he: וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: But mine enemies are strong in health; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied. .

verses.he: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת רדופי [רָֽדְפִי]־טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: They also that repay evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

verses.he: אַל־תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.en: Forsake me not, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me.

verses.he: ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
